tools.reels.label: Listening reels
tools.reels.about: Render one transition or a reel of them, check beats by ear, and play reels in a browser.

tools.key_benchmark.label: Key method benchmark
tools.key_benchmark.about: Score a replacement key method against S-KEY's stored keys on this library, read-only, for choosing S-KEY's Cloud replacement.

tools.set_mix.label: Whole-set render
tools.set_mix.about: Render a planned set straight to one file from the command line.

tools.stem_preview.label: Stem preview
tools.stem_preview.about: Hear two songs' stems side by side from the command line.

tools.listening_room.label: Listening Room
tools.listening_room.about: A Cloud page for judging transitions by ear: each transition in the current mix is played two ways on this device, blind, as A and B, and the answers are kept in this browser until the reveal says which was which. Version 1 compares the browser player before and after early planning, one level for every song and patient analysis (cloud.seam_lead).

tools.old_planner.label: Rolling set planner
tools.old_planner.about: The original rolling set plan, before mix ideas.
